newsitem.title: CANADA: Concord Pacific shareholders acquire new shares.
newsitem.headline: Concord Pacific shareholders acquire new shares.

text.p: Shareholders of Concord Pacific Holdings Ltd, owner of the former Expo 86 site in Vancouver, said they will become shareholders in Burcon International Developments Inc, a North American real estate development, investment and management organization with assets over C$1 billion, based in Vancouver, B.C.
Burcon is the controlling shareholder of Oxford Properties Group Inc, and is a publicly listed company on both the Toronto Stock Exchange and the Vancouver Stock Exchange.

The arrangement involves the initial acquisition by Burcon of Concord Pacific's development lands and existing projects under construction for approximately C$250 million, in addition to three options covering the remainder of the Concord Pacific Place lands. In connection with the financing of this transaction the Concord shareholders will subscribe for approximately 8.0 million common shares and receive warrants to acquire an additional 8.1 million common shares. Burcon contemplates a public equity offering to raise additional funds for this arrangement and other activities.

International Tak Cheung Holdings (ITC) and Hutchison Whampoa are currently Burcon's principal beneficial shareholders. Upon completion of this transaction and the conversion of certain convertible debentures into common shares, Burcon's principal beneficial shareholders will also include Huey Tai International and its subsidiary Asean Resources and the Hui family of Vancouver-based Adex Group.
ITC Chairman Charles Chan will serve as Burcon's new executive chairman and current Burcon president and chief executive officer Mr. Aaron Ip will serve as its new executive vice chairman.
